title: ephemeral-prefetch-allocator-and-context-fragment-sampler
author: Sasha Chen
description: Motivation: We observed suboptimal latency variance for short interactive requests when KV-cache hitrates were low and prefetching policies were static. This PR introduces an Ephemeral Prefetch Allocator and a Context Fragment Sampler designed to reduce token-tail latency and warmup cost for multi-model mixed workloads. High level: 1) Ephemeral Prefetch Allocator: lightweight runtime component that opportunistically allocates short-lived prefetch slots for recently accessed cache prefixes; policies are signal-driven (recent-access frequency + sequenced token entropy) so allocations expire quickly under contention. 2) Context Fragment Sampler: offline workload synthesizer that breaks real sessions into fragments preserving token-level distribution and prompt/response boundaries; used by the allocator to estimate effective reuse and avoid overprefetching. 3) Integration harness and reporting pipeline: a new bench harness that runs end-to-end microbench scenarios, collects per-token latency histograms, prefetch hit/miss rates, and memory occupancy traces, and uploads compact reports for the aggregator UI. Backwards compatibility: allocator is opt-in via bench config and does not change runtime defaults. Checklist: implemented allocator, sampler, unit tests, integration bench scenario, CI job, docs. Related: ENG-3781 experiments and the warmup-cost initiative. Commits: list below. Files changed: bench/allocator/ephemeral_allocator.py; bench/sampler/context_fragmenter.py; bench/harness/ephemeral_scenario.yaml; bench/reports/prefetch_reporter.py; tests/test_ephemeral_allocator.py; docs/bench/ephemeral_prefetch.md; telemetry/mappings/prefetch_metrics.json; small changes to bench/runner/driver.py and bench/README.md. Expected impact: p50 unchanged; p95/p99 tail reductions of 10-30% in short session mixes, 8-12% total token savings in mixed workloads in our lab. Merger notes: squash-merge with a minimal commit message and follow-up iterations planned for policy tuning and an autoscaling hook.

review_threads: Arjun Patel: Could you add a short diagram showing the allocator lifecycle?; Sasha Chen: Added diagram to docs and an ascii lifecycle in the allocator module header.

Marta Gómez: The eviction condition seems aggressive under high contention, can we add a soft-throttle?; Sasha Chen: Added exponential backoff on reallocation attempts and a config knob (ephemeral_backoff_ms) with sane defaults.

Liam O'Neill: Unit tests pass locally but CI flaked on telemetry upload step; can you add retry logic?; Sasha Chen: Added idempotent retry with jitter and added a lightweight mock in CI to avoid flaky external calls.
ci_log_summary: CI started: lint -> unit tests -> bench-smoke -> bench-report-upload -> integration. Initial run: bench-smoke failed (transient ordering race in allocator), fixed by adding slot ordering guard; rerun completed successfully. Coverage: allocator 92%, sampler 88%; bench smoke adds synthetic end-to-end runs (2m). All checks green before merge.
release_notes: Introduce an opt-in Ephemeral Prefetch Allocator and Context Fragment Sampler for benchmark lab workloads to reduce tail latency and warmup token cost. Enabled via bench config 'use_ephemeral_prefetch'.
